TLDR: The large deletion from the old-terminal section does not remove the requirements for restoring the app window, showing startup refusals, or removing the obsolete bundled tmux safely.
Details: Assigned patch lines 20–71 delete unrelated desktop/provisioning paragraphs from the old tmux section. Checked their replacement locations at the same revision: SPEC_impl.md:7268–7283 retains the window geometry and pre-window diagnostic rules; :7996–8021 retains tmux-free supervisor setup, the legacy environment variable rule, and removal of only the private bundled tmux after supervisor replacement. Exact retained text includes "The geometry check requires the complete saved frame to fit one connected monitor and avoids arithmetic overflow", "Every pre-window desktop refusal prints one plain `farhelm-desktop: ...` stderr line and exits 1", and "it always names the private lib directory's `tmux`, never a file beside a registered binary that lives elsewhere". The deleted general no-tmux paragraph is covered by the replacement provisioning text and SPEC.md:2896–2901 terminal-host environment rule. This is relocation, with no established behavior or safety-contract regression. Suggested bucket: other. Confidence: confirmed by pinned source comparison; no execution. proposed_drop: source refutation, the removed requirements remain in the same pinned document at the references above. possible_cover: none searched. Could-be-highest: false; no established security or loss-of-work route from this relocation. Caveat: this candidate assesses removal/replacement of these requirements, not independent correctness of desktop persistence or provisioning code.

Reviewed commit: f96dd4363d97dc7e07dea5b8947c96be6bf912e8

## TLDR

The section rename does not leave the reviewed specifications pointing readers to a missing old-terminal section.

## Details

Synthesis checked whether renaming `Terminal substrate: private tmux server` broke the surrounding contract references. A pinned `git grep` across SPEC.md, SPEC_impl.md and the changed old_terminals.rs comment found no old title or `terminal-substrate-private-tmux-server` anchor. SPEC_impl.md:2161 and :5687 use the exact new section title, `Ending the old private tmux server`, whose heading is at :2780. The module comment at crates/farhelm-supervisor/src/service/core/old_terminals.rs:6–8 names the same new section: "SPEC_impl.md, `Ending the old private tmux server`" (rendered there across two comment lines). This refutes the suspected broken reference within the checked interfaces.

Suggested bucket: other. Confidence: confirmed by source search and reading the pinned module comment; no execution. proposed_drop: source refutation, callers name the existing new heading and no retired title/anchor remains in the checked specifications. possible_cover: none searched. Could-be-highest: false; the considered consequence was documentation navigation only, with no established security or loss-of-work route. Caveat: the check is confined to the reviewed specifications and their changed implementation comment, not every file in the repository.
